Hook stdin payloads copied verbatim from the examples in https://code.claude.com/docs/en/hooks
(fetched 2026-10-18, documenting Claude Code 2.1.30x). They are documentation examples, not captures
from a running CLI.

notification_idle_prompt.json is notification_permission_prompt.json with the documented
`idle_prompt` notification type (fetched 2026-11-03); its message text is illustrative.
